title: What If You Woke Up a Sleepwalker?

scenes.text: What if you woke up a sleepwalker? The old warning comes from a belief about the soul.
People once believed the soul left the body in sleep, and waking someone could trap it outside.
Sleepwalking is common. About seven percent of people do it at some point, and far more kids than adults.
If you wake one, they won't be harmed. They'll be confused, groggy, maybe startled, and won't remember a thing.
The real danger is the walking itself: stairs, doors, and sharp corners.
Sleep experts say guide them gently back to bed. And if they're near danger, waking them is the right call.
